tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Brand color 1 of 2. Text, money already spent (solid fill), primary borders, the over-budget pill and the toast. 17.7:1 on paper (light), 15.7:1 (dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Brand color 2 of 2. Planned spend (hatched), paybacks, the pace line, primary buttons and the + button, focus rings. 6.4:1 on paper (light), 8.6:1 (dark). Paper text on accent: same ratio.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Card and sheet surface. Every other neutral is ink or accent mixed into paper.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground behind cards, input fields, meter track. Ink 5% into paper.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Quiet fill for neutral chips. Ink 9% into paper.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and card borders. Ink 16% into paper. Decorative only: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: labels, dates, meta lines. Ink 66% into paper. 5.7:1 on paper, 5.2:1 on bg (light).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, wishlist items set to buy, the light stripe in hatching, the match box. Accent 12% into paper. Accent text on it: 5.4:1.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", "Zen Kaku Gothic New", system-ui, -apple-system, "Hiragino Sans", sans-serif
families.num: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

styles.name: amount-hero
styles.usage: The one number per screen: what is left to spend. Tabular figures.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Row amounts, per-day figure, totals. Right-aligned in lists.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Source and card tags on charges.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Month name in the top bar, sheet titles.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Secondary lines under a row, hints, leads in sheets.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between rows of a list, between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between cards on the page; inside list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and the page side gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Space above the meter for the pace label.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything. The system has no rounded corners: cards, buttons, chips, sheets, the + button.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tap target: chips, segmented controls, checkboxes rows.

tokens.name: column
tokens.usage: Max content width; wider screens center one phone-width column.
